title: Realize a separable residue element in an admissible subalgebra
statement: Let k be a field and B an Artinian local k-algebra. Let A₀⊆B be a local admissible subalgebra [def-weil-pbc-popescu-admissible-subalgebra] relative to m_B whose inclusion is local. Give K=residueField B an F₀=residueField A₀ algebra structure with a compatible k-scalar tower and satisfying algebraMap F₀ K(residue_A₀(a₀))=residue_B(a₀) for every a₀∈A₀. For any element β∈K separable over F₀ [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension], there exist a local admissible k-subalgebra A⊆B, an inclusion A₀⊆A, and a∈A with residue_B(a)=β. There is an F₀-algebra structure on residueField A with compatible k-scalar tower, agreeing with the inclusion on residues of A₀, and formally étale over F₀. No positive-characteristic or unit hypothesis is required.

source.place: Tags 07FH and 07FI; algebraic case of 07FI after extraction of a separable power, finite étale lifting and embedding into the ambient Artinian local algebra.

proof.text: Residue compatibility hmap and surjectivity of A₀→F₀ identify the supplied F₀-algebra structure on K with the canonical residue algebra of inclusion. Admissibility supplies Artinianness and flatness of A₀→B. Apply Algebra.exists_finiteEtale_artinian_residue_lift to β to obtain a finite étale local Artinian A₀-algebra D, a flat local homomorphism g:D→B factoring inclusion, and d∈D with residue_B(g(d))=β.

The local flat map g is faithfully flat, hence injective. Make it a k-algebra homomorphism using its factorization on A₀. Its image A is a k-subalgebra containing A₀ and is isomorphic to D. Transfer its finite module and étale structures over A₀. Finiteness over the Artinian A₀ makes A Artinian; essential finite type over k follows from finiteness over A₀ and composition. Inclusion A→B is flat by composition with the inverse isomorphism. For the local étale map A₀→A, Mathlib Algebra.FormallyUnramified.map_maximalIdeal gives m_A=m_A₀ A; extending to B gives m_A B=m_A₀ B=m_B. Thus A is admissible.

Take a to be the image of d. Its residue equality is the equality supplied by the lifting theorem. Choose the canonical residue algebra of the local map A₀→A; quotient functoriality gives its compatibility on residues and its k-scalar tower. The finite étale local extension induces a finite separable residue-field extension (Mathlib RingTheory.Unramified.LocalRing instances), so Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_isSeparable supplies formal étaleness.

proof_origin.place: Tag 07FI, algebraic branch; use the existing Artinian separable residue lift, then its injective image and the canonical residue algebra. The entire proof is implemented without new holes.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_popescu_separable_residue_realization
    (k : Type u) (B : Type v) [Field k] [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
    [IsArtinianRing B] [IsLocalRing B]
    (A₀ : Subalgebra k B) [IsLocalRing A₀]
    (hA₀ : A₀.IsPopescuAdmissible (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B))
    [IsLocalHom A₀.val]
    [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A₀) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B)]
    [IsScalarTower k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A₀) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B)]
    (hmap : ∀ a₀ : A₀, algebraMap (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A₀)
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B) (IsLocalRing.residue A₀ a₀) =
        IsLocalRing.residue B (a₀ : B))
    (β : IsLocalRing.ResidueField B) (hβ : IsSeparable (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A₀) β) :
    ∃ (A : Subalgebra k B) (_ : IsLocalRing A), ∃ hle : A₀ ≤ A,
      A.IsPopescuAdmissible (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) ∧
      ∃ a : A, IsLocalRing.residue B (a : B) = β ∧
        ∃ (alg : Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A₀) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)),
          letI := alg
          IsScalarTower k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A₀) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) ∧
          (∀ a₀ : A₀, algebraMap (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A₀)
            (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) (IsLocalRing.residue A₀ a₀) =
              IsLocalRing.residue A (Subalgebra.inclusion hle a₀)) ∧
          Algebra.FormallyEtale (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A₀)
            (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)
